headline: 3 vault contracts catalogued (2 Ethereum, 1 Base) from a merged DefiLlama adapter PR; no official deployments doc, GitHub repo or audits found; 5 of 8 chains have zero addresses.

findings.text: Direct block-explorer name-tag searches were not performed. The fetch tool only accepts URLs that already appeared in the conversation, and the defipunkd read API was also rejected for the discovered addresses. Zero explorer-sourced addresses.

No official deployments page was found. The tulipa.capital website carries marketing copy, a contact email and a Partners / Dashboards nav, with no contract addresses. DefiLlama and the Syntetika docs also list none.
No audit links are pinned or discovered. Tulipa is a curator and the audited contracts belong to the underlying vault platforms (Ember, Lagoon, Term), so none apply here.
No GitHub repository for Tulipa was recorded or found. A moneytulip/tulip-contracts search hit belongs to a different project, Tulip.money, and is excluded.

Three vaults on two chains (Ethereum 2, Base 1) were recorded from a merged DefiLlama-Adapters PR. DefiLlama's page lists TVL on Ethereum, TAC, Berachain, Avalanche, Monad, BOB and BSC. No addresses were obtained for TAC, Berachain, Avalanche, Monad, BOB or BSC.
No factory contract was identified, so no children were enumerated.

All three recorded addresses are ERC-4626 vaults on the Ember platform, per the PR text, and are classified role 'vault' with actor_class 'unknown' because no bytecode was read. The Syntetika docs say Tulipa co-signs on-chain price updates for the Syntetika vaults, but the signer or owner addresses were not found.
Only addresses present in the fetched PR page body are in admin_addresses. Addresses seen only in search snippets are listed in unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Walked the Tulipa website, DefiLlama page, Syntetika partners docs and DefiLlama-Adapters PR #21779. Catalogued 3 vault addresses, with no admin, multisig or timelock addresses found, so grade is unknown by design.

evidence.shows: Official website describes Tulipa as a DeFi risk curator that manages vaults for lending markets, launched summer 2024. Contact is info@tulipa.capital. No contract addresses, docs link, GitHub or audits are listed.

Merged PR (Oct 21, 2026) listing three Ember ERC-4626 vaults managed by Tulipa: Ethereum Tulipa Multi-Asset RWA (tulPRWA) 0xaa1d6fa2bc21d5518dcbb0fa37e07b44c9899d26 (USDC), Ethereum Enigma ONE USD 0xbfda6fb6e61bdeb2a2ce3befebbd4939d0d828aa (USDC, co-managed with Hilbert), Base Syntetika BTC Hilbert Basis+ / hBTC 0x9c2dcdbdb3f0a0f628d1112bbcabd9ae75353df3 (cbBTC, co-managed with Hilbert).

Tulipa is the external curator of the Syntetika vaults. It manages the deposit/redemption queue and co-signs every on-chain price update. Syntetika's CEO is also CIO of Tulipa. Ember supplies the ERC-4626 vault contracts.
DefiLlama page showing TVL by chain: Ethereum, TAC, Berachain, Avalanche, Monad, BOB, BSC and Base. Category is Risk Curators. No addresses are listed.

unknowns: D1-offchain: Block-explorer name-tag searches (etherscan, basescan, snowtrace, bscscan, etc.) not performed because the fetch tool rejects URLs not previously seen. The defipunkd /api/contract/read call for 0xaa1d6fa2bc21d5518dcbb0fa37e07b44c9899d26 was also rejected. No on-chain reads were possible this run.
D1: Two web searches and the fetched pages surfaced no Tulipa-tagged multisig, timelock or owner addresses.
D2: No official deployed-contracts page found on tulipa.capital. The Dashboards nav item links to '#', and the Partners page was not fetched.
D3: No audit links pinned or discovered. Audits of the underlying platforms (Ember, Lagoon, Term) were not walked.

D4: No Tulipa GitHub repo identified. The registries/curators.js file in DefiLlama-Adapters, which holds the full vault list across all chains, was not fetched, only the PR page. Fetching it is the highest-value next step.
D5: chain Berachain: zero addresses surfaced from website, DefiLlama page, PR and searches.

D5: chain Avalanche: zero addresses surfaced. A search snippet mentions a 'Turtle Avalanche USDC' vault curated by Tulipa on Lagoon at tradingstrategy.ai, but no address was seen and the page fetch failed.
D5: chain BOB: zero addresses surfaced.
D5: chain Binance (BSC): zero addresses surfaced.
D5: chain Monad: zero addresses surfaced.
D5: chain TAC: zero addresses surfaced, although DefiLlama shows TVL there.
D5: chain Ethereum: the 2 vaults found come from the PR only. Lagoon vaults on Ethereum (Tulipa co-curates Flagship cbBTC with 9Summits) were seen only in search snippets.

D8: Snippet-only sighting, not fetched, so not in admin_addresses: Lagoon Flagship cbBTC vault on Ethereum, 0xb09f761cb13baca8ec087ac476647361b6314f98 (app.lagoon.finance/vault/1/...). Its Owner/Curator is shown only truncated as 0xb65b…3bc4 and the Valuation Manager as 0x30a3…b244.

D8: Snippet-only sighting, not fetched, so not in admin_addresses: Term vault 'Tulipa Capital USDT0' on Plasma (chain 9745), 0xAf293898269AC7F366d0E05052B5fDfEe8C8052C, per vaults.fyi. Plasma is not in protocol.chains, and the page fetch failed.
D6: No factory identified. Lagoon and Ember vault factories were not located.
D7: Role and actor_class for the three vaults are tentative. No bytecode or owner() reads were possible.
D7: The Syntetika price-publishing address and curator Safe(s) are not published in the fetched pages, so their addresses are unknown.

protocol_metadata.about: Tulipa Capital is a DeFi risk curator that manages public vaults and lending markets for protocols and projects, with a stated focus on capital preservation over headline yield. Depositors put assets such as USDC or cbBTC into ERC-4626-style curated vaults on platforms like Ember, where Tulipa manages the deposit/redemption queue and co-signs price updates for some vaults, as the Syntetika docs describe.
